selectionMetric: sum of conditional Tier 1 exact events across P7 temporal synthetic, Harmony Support dev, and P9 usage v2 dev

parameters.onsetSupport: select onset plus already-sounding support with largest total remaining overlap; tie to earlier onset

validationPolicy: evaluate selected frozen policy once on public Harmony Support validation; never inspect sealed holdout or private witness
limitations: Research policy is frozen for validation despite failing dev promotion conditions; validation is for generalization diagnosis, not retuning.
